description: vibekit, the suite's design layer, and nothing else: one grouped pull request when @superjackfruitlabs/vibekit-ui, @superjackfruitlabs/vibekit-frame or @superjackfruitlabs/vibekit-docs publishes a new version. It never merges; repositories that merge on green extend vibekit-automerge instead.

packageRules.description: Every other dependency stays as the repository has it: no other pull requests.
The three vibekit packages, together in one pull request, keeping each range's ^ and moving it to the new version.
